format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

nature_colors <- c("#0173B2", "#DE8F05", "#029E73", "#CC78BC",
                  "#CA9161", "#949494", "#ECE133", "#56B4E9")

theme_nature <- function(base_size = 8) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}

theme_set(theme_nature())

dat <- read_csv("data/processed_data.csv") |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  mutate(
    phase = case_when(
      year <= 2008 ~ "Phase 1 (2000-08)",
      year <= 2013 ~ "Phase 2 (2009-13)",
      TRUE ~ "Phase 3 (2014-24)"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("Phase 1 (2000-08)", "Phase 2 (2009-13)", "Phase 3 (2014-24)")),
    collab_type = factor(collab_type, 
                        levels = c("JP-dominated", "Balanced", "VN-dominated", "Other"))
  )
```

## Authorship Proportion Evolution
```{r fig-prop-distribution}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

ggplot(dat, aes(x = prop_vn_authors)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, fill = "#4A90E2", color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", 
             color = "#E85D75", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = Inf, label = "Perfect balance", 
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3, color = "#E85D75") +
  labs(x = "Vietnamese author proportion", y = "Frequency")
```
```{r fig-prop-over-time}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    mean_prop = mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    ci_lower = mean_prop - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = mean_prop + 1.96 * se
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean_prop)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), 
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "#4A90E2") +
  geom_line(color = "#4A90E2", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#4A90E2", size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", 
             color = "#E85D75", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(2009, 2014), linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.3, 0.6), 
                    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Mean Vietnamese author proportion")
```
```{r tbl-prop-by-phase}
dat |>
  group_by(phase) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `Mean prop` = round(mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `SD` = round(sd(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 1. Vietnamese authorship proportion by phase")
```

## Leadership Transitions
```{r fig-leadership-trends}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  mutate(leadership = case_when(
    vn_led == 1 ~ "VN-led",
    jp_led == 1 ~ "JP-led",
    TRUE ~ "Other-led"
  ) |> factor(levels = c("JP-led", "VN-led", "Other-led"))) |>
  count(year, leadership) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pct, fill = leadership)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dotted", 
             color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("VN-led" = "#4A90E2", "JP-led" = "#E85D75", 
               "Other-led" = "#95B8A8")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), 
                    expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Proportion of publications", fill = NULL)
```
```{r fig-leadership-absolute}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  mutate(leadership = case_when(
    vn_led == 1 ~ "VN-led",
    jp_led == 1 ~ "JP-led",
    TRUE ~ "Other-led"
  )) |>
  count(year, leadership) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, color = leadership)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("VN-led" = "#4A90E2", "JP-led" = "#E85D75", 
               "Other-led" = "#95B8A8")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of publications", color = NULL)
```
```{r tbl-leadership-by-phase}
dat |>
  mutate(leadership = case_when(
    vn_led == 1 ~ "VN-led",
    jp_led == 1 ~ "JP-led",
    TRUE ~ "Other-led"
  )) |>
  group_by(phase, leadership) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) |>
  select(phase, leadership, n, pct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = leadership, 
              values_from = c(n, pct),
              names_glue = "{leadership}_{.value}") |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 2. Leadership distribution by phase")
```

## Collaboration Balance
```{r fig-collab-type-dist}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  count(collab_type) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = pct, fill = collab_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("JP-dominated" = "#E85D75", "Balanced" = "#95B8A8",
               "VN-dominated" = "#4A90E2", "Other" = "#E8B861")
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 3) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7)) +
  labs(fill = NULL)
```
```{r fig-collab-type-trends}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  count(year, collab_type) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pct, fill = collab_type)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("JP-dominated" = "#E85D75", "Balanced" = "#95B8A8",
               "VN-dominated" = "#4A90E2", "Other" = "#E8B861")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
                    expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Proportion of publications", fill = NULL)
```
```{r tbl-collab-balance-phase}
dat |>
  group_by(phase, collab_type) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) |>
  select(-n) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = phase, values_from = pct) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 3. Collaboration balance by phase (%)")
```

## VJU Impact on Equity
```{r fig-vju-comparison}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  mutate(vju = if_else(vju_affiliated == 1, "VJU-affiliated", "Non-VJU")) |>
  filter(!is.na(prop_vn_authors)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = vju, y = prop_vn_authors, fill = vju)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3,
               fill = "white", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "#E85D75", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("VJU-affiliated" = "#4A90E2", 
                               "Non-VJU" = "#95B8A8")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Vietnamese author proportion") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
```{r tbl-vju-metrics}
dat |>
  mutate(vju = if_else(vju_affiliated == 1, "VJU", "Non-VJU")) |>
  group_by(vju) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `Mean prop_vn` = round(mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `VN-led (%)` = round(100 * mean(vn_led == 1), 1),
    `Balanced (%)` = round(100 * mean(collab_type == "Balanced"), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 4. VJU vs non-VJU equity indicators")
```
```{r fig-vju-leadership}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  mutate(
    vju = if_else(vju_affiliated == 1, "VJU-affiliated", "Non-VJU"),
    leadership = case_when(
      vn_led == 1 ~ "VN-led",
      jp_led == 1 ~ "JP-led",
      TRUE ~ "Other-led"
    )
  ) |>
  count(vju, leadership) |>
  group_by(vju) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = leadership, y = pct, fill = vju)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct, 1), "%")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("VJU-affiliated" = "#4A90E2",
                               "Non-VJU" = "#95B8A8")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percentage", fill = NULL)
```

## Temporal Equity Convergence Test
```{r fig-convergence-test}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  group_by(phase) |>
  summarise(
    mean_prop = mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    ci_lower = mean_prop - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = mean_prop + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = phase, y = mean_prop)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4A90E2", alpha = 0.6, width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "#E85D75", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(mean_prop * 100, 1), "%")),
            vjust = -2, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                    limits = c(0, 0.6)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean Vietnamese author proportion")
```
```{r tbl-anova-test}
model <- aov(prop_vn_authors ~ phase, data = dat)
broom::tidy(model) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4))) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 5. ANOVA test for phase differences")
```
